entries.title: Sun in the 1st house
entries.body: This placement links identity and self-direction with identity and how you approach new situations. In astrology, a house means an area of life, not a physical building. Use this combination to reflect on your own priorities in that area. What approach feels authentic to you, and where would you like to experiment? It does not establish facts about your past or predict events.

Use this combination to reflect on what attracts you and what needs a closer look in that area. What skill or conversation deserves a little regular practice? It does not establish facts about your past or predict events.

entries.title: Rahu in the 4th house
entries.body: This placement links ambition and unfamiliar experiences with home, belonging and your private life. In astrology, a house means an area of life, not a physical building. Use this combination to reflect on what attracts you and what needs a closer look in that area. What would make your everyday surroundings feel more supportive? It does not establish facts about your past or predict events.

It does not establish facts about your past or predict events.

It does not establish facts about your past or predict events.
